question: Is the current focused Testbox and CI evidence sufficient to land the trusted tooling before the terminal immutable replay, or must an exact-current-head historical reconciliation be produced before merge?
rationale: The official terminal replay is designed to use landed trusted-main tooling, while the PR simultaneously states a pre-merge HOLD tied to an older head; automation cannot choose which evidence boundary release owners intend.

options.title: Land, then replay before publication
options.body: Approve the trusted tooling change now, update the stale hold text, and keep every release publication path blocked until the terminal reconciliation succeeds on landed main.

options.title: Require pre-merge dry-run proof
options.body: Keep the PR draft until an equivalent immutable historical reconciliation is run with exact current-head tooling and attached as review evidence.

options.title: Pause the ledger redesign
options.body: Defer the branch and keep the canonical issue open if neither proof sequence provides an acceptable release trust boundary.

recommendation.title: Land, then replay before publication
recommendation.body: Approve the trusted tooling change now, update the stale hold text, and keep every release publication path blocked until the terminal reconciliation succeeds on landed main.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main release workflow history and authorship of the final publisher integration make this the strongest available owner for the proof-boundary decision.
